name: GalaxyCon New Orleans
blurb: A former New Orleans stop on the GalaxyCon tour, absent from the organizer's current multi-city schedule.
notes: No dedicated page exists at galaxycon.com/pages/galaxycon-new-orleans (404), matching the discovery note. GalaxyCon's own 'Live Events' page (galaxycon.com/pages/live-events) lists every upcoming GalaxyCon/Animate!/Nightmare Weekend show in order from today through October 2027 — St. Louis, Columbus, Animate Raleigh, Richmond, Oklahoma City, Nashville, Raleigh, Animate Orlando, San Jose, Des Moines, Animate Philadelphia, Nightmare Weekend Raleigh, St. Louis again — and New Orleans is not on it, nor is it among the current 'LIVE EVENTS GALAXYCON' city list in the site nav (Columbus, Des Moines, Nashville, Oklahoma City, Raleigh, Richmond, San Jose, St. Louis). GalaxyCon New Orleans debuted July 11-13, 2025 at the New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center (per news coverage, e.g. WGNO); third-party listings also show a July 2026 date, which would have already passed by the 2026-10-05 check date, but that edition isn't confirmed here from an official source. With no page, no future date, and no mention anywhere in the organizer's complete forward schedule, this reads as dropped from the touring lineup rather than merely 'not yet announced', so it's filed inactive instead of active with an empty edition list. Guests not researched since there is no current edition.
